US Powerball Results

Looking for the latest US Powerball results? Ready to discover if you're dreams are about to come true? You're in the right place.

The US Powerball lottery happens every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at 10.59pm Eastern Standard Time (EST). We bring you the most up-to-date lottery results, right here at LottosOnline.

Have you won the jackpot?

The USA Powerball has nine prize payout tiers. Here's how it works.

Five main numbers (from 1-69) are selected, followed separately by one Powerball number (from 1-26). To win the jackpot, you'll need to match all five main numbers plus the one Powerball number. The jackpot size starts at a minimum of $40 million, rolling over to the following week if there are no jackpot winners.

Even if your ticket entries have matched just the Powerball number, you will be a winner. Take a look at our US Powerball prize breakdown to find out more.

To make life easier we deliver your USA Powerball results straight to your inbox. It's the quickest, simplest way to stay updated. You might find yourself transformed into a millionaire with a click of a button! Good luck!

Draws are conducted every Wednesday and Saturday.
